name: 5-MeO-DIBF
summary: The drug is related to tryptamine, it is the Benzofuran analogue of 5-MeO-DiPT. The drug is suspected to be a serotonin receptor partial agonist by some. There is limited information on this drug.

pharmacology.text: Analogues of 5-MeO-DiBF have been found to interact with serotonin receptors including the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2 receptors.

uses.text: The drug has been sold online as a novel designer drug starting in 2015.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is a tryptamine with the nitrogen of its indole ring replaced by oxygen, turning the core into a benzofuran. Chemists call such a swap a bioisosteric replacement.
fact.zh: 它是把色胺吲哚環中的氮換成氧，使核心變成苯并呋喃。化學家把這樣的置換稱為生物同性取代（bioisosteric replacement）。
fact.zhHans: 它是把色胺吲哚环中的氮换成氧，使内核变成苯并呋喃。化学家把这样的置换称为生物同性取代（bioisosteric replacement）。
